verdict.rationale: ROCm, AMD's open-source compute stack for Instinct GPUs, is documented as supporting Linux. The Instinct docs add AMD SMI for managing GPUs and drivers, plus a Kubernetes GPU Operator, Device Plugin and Container Toolkit, which together point to a Linux-centric deployment story. However, the pack contains no MI355X-specific Linux driver release notes, and the only hands-on community benchmark (8×MI355X serving Kimi K3) never states its OS or driver setup, so independent Linux testing of this part is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented Linux driver releases/changelogs naming MI355X, independent hands-on Linux testing of the MI355X with driver/kernel details, and explicit statements that MI355X is supported on specific Linux distributions.
